state.mtbs_rule: Derive state only from the first two Event_ID characters and require the result to be exactly ID, OR, or WA.
state.wfigs_rule: Require attr_POOState to equal exactly US- plus the canonical MTBS state.

exact_source_representation_mappings.conflict_rule: Any missing value, non-exact identifier match, state disagreement after the one declared representation mapping, or category disagreement is unknown and not eligible.
exact_source_representation_mappings.wfigs_snapshot_query_rule: The fixed snapshot query may filter only the approved 2021-2022 discovery-date window and exact state values US-ID, US-OR, and US-WA before row-level evaluation.

unchanged_rules: Jurisdictions remain exactly Idaho, Oregon, and Washington.
The 1,000-acre minimum remains required in both MTBS and WFIGS.
All 68 prior identities remain permanently excluded.
Exact identifier matching, maturity, duplicate, ecology, HLS metadata, 12-slot-per-state, 36-slot-total, and INCONCLUSIVE shortfall rules remain unchanged.
No model, label, spectral, metric, imagery-body, or denied-field evidence may enter eligibility.
No pilot or final event, AOI, or split role may be selected in Milestone 1.
released_actions: Capture the bounded WFIGS snapshot under the exact reviewed state representation.
Evaluate M1-U005 rows using only the exact reviewed state and incident-type mappings plus all unchanged frozen rules.
